explanation.body: Its forecast takes this form: probability and distribution, over next 30 outcomes for the displayed figure. It is graded on how often its stated ranges contain what actually happens, checked against the width of those ranges. It would be ended if over the first 10 matured triggers, shrinkage forecasts are not better calibrated than a no-change forecast. It counts as proven at first 10 matured triggers.
explanation.summary: Stake a dated prediction on what every young headline number on this site will read after its next 30 outcomes land, before anyone quotes it at face value.

how_words: For each figure: take its long-run family rate, measure how wide the honest range around the young figure is, and let that width decide how much weight the long-run rate gets. A very young figure gets pulled a long way; an older one barely moves. The range staked is the middle 80% of where that arithmetic puts the figure after 30 more outcomes, and the chance printed beside it is the chance the figure moves at least one third of the way back toward its long-run rate. Where no long-run record exists yet for a family, the neutral 50% is used and stamped as neutral.
idea_words: A young number looks surer than it is. A rate built on 6 tests can read 100%, and a rate built on 22 can read 64%, while the honest range around each is very wide. This page watches every young success rate displayed anywhere on this site, meaning any rate built on fewer than 30 finished outcomes, and stakes a dated prediction on what each one will read after its next 30 outcomes land. Young numbers usually drift back toward the long-run rate for their kind; each prediction below is built by pulling the young number part of the way toward that long-run rate, by an amount fixed in advance from how wide the young number's own honest range is, never adjusted figure by figure.
issuance_words: Every figure below was already on display before this page existed. Their predictions are dated October 29, 2026, the day this page first read them, and are written in the same public record as every other forecast on this site. Nothing is backdated to when a figure was first displayed, and a figure already under prediction is never re-staked: its prediction stands until its next 30 outcomes land.
kill_words: Over the first 10 figures to mature, this page's pulled-toward-normal predictions must beat a simple no-change prediction, one that says each figure simply stays where it is, on both measures: how close the middle of the prediction lands to the real figure, and how well the move-toward-normal chance scores. Failing either measure retires this page, and its record stays up intact.
